units: Ex. R. s. 1 (ref. to Ex. I, 16) אין אבנים אלא ס׳ (gloss: שהוא דבר קשה) obhnayim means a block (which means a hard object); מה יוצר זה … וס׳ באמצע as the potter sits with one leg on each side of the block (mould); Sot. 11ᵇ.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>, end <he>כזה שהוא … על הס׳</he> as one striking with the hammer on the block (anvil); <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:1">Sabb. XII, 1</cite>.
Snh. VII, 3 מניחין … על הס׳ they put his head on the (executioner’s) block; a. fr.—Esp. ס׳ של שקמה (or sub. שקמה) the trunk of the sycamore tree.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:8">Kil. I, 8</cite> <he>אין … בתוך ס׳ של ש׳</he> you must not plant vegetables in a trunk &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:9">B. Bath. IV, 9</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 1:1">Pesik. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 65:22">Is. LXV, 22</cite>) [read:] <he>זה עץ הס׳ שעושה וכ׳</he> that means the wood of the sycamore trunk, which endures in the ground for six hundred years; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:6">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>כשקמה הזו</he>); a. e.—Pl. <he>סַדָּנִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:5">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> (expl. <he>עמק השדים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 14:3">Gen. XIV, 3</cite>) <he>שהוא מגדל ס׳</he> which produces sycamore trees.
